repos.what: Directional wiki for the Context Model project (codename `pig-sl`): vision, architecture, component model, decisions, observed materials.
repos.notes: Do not auto-load `y-synthesized-documents/` unless a human names a file there. Read its `AGENTS.md` before making changes inside the checkout.

repos.what: Process Mining Solutions team miscellaneous code (e.g. the OGDF/SPQR block-structure discovery pipeline).
Internal LaTeX documents of the Process Mining Innovation team.
Object-Centric Data Model (OCDM) prototyping environment: Data Model Picker, Process Configurator, filtering framework, Case Designer.

Engineering Central — the Engineering department's single source of truth for general engineering information: SDLC, change management, platform freezes, testing, onboarding, local development, developing with AI.
Documentation and Architecture Decision Records for the Celonis EMS Platform.
Content of the Celonis Engineering microsite — the public-facing narrative of how Engineering works.
Celonis' context and skill foundation for autonomous SDLC — the house style for agent skills, rules and agent-in-the-loop development.
Source of truth about Backstage/Roadie resources — the service-catalog entities behind celonis.roadie.so (Celodrome) and its TechDocs.
repos.notes: Roadie itself is hosted Backstage (https://celonis.roadie.so, also https://www.celonis.dev), not a repository. This checkout plus each service's own `catalog-info.yaml` / `.roadierc` is the closest on-disk equivalent.

repos.what: Shared GitHub Actions workflows — the golden-path CI/CD every Celonis service repository calls into.
SRE team documentation: reliability practice, on-call, incident handling, observability.
Cross-platform operational runbooks — the step-by-step remediations linked from alerts.
Runbooks for monitoring and investigating Data Pipeline services, plus ops-cop responsibilities and common mitigations.
Platform TechDocs — how the underlying Celonis platform (clusters, realms, gateways) is structured and operated.

Studio Platform team knowledge base: per-initiative `projects/` (multi-user-collaboration, isolated-asset-rendering, granular-asset-permissions, context-model, …) plus a cross-cutting `knowledge/wiki/` (arch, components, operations, postmortems).
Documentation owned by the CMP (Content Management Platform) team — the published counterpart to `studio-platform-hq`.
Saola (query engine) team wiki — engine internals, infrastructure, trainings, operations.
Centralized documentation for the Celostar ecosystem (the StarRocks-based analytical stack).
Org-wide developer-facing documentation for the CeloAI team — the AI Gateway, model access and AI platform services.
repos.notes: This is the documentation behind `search/llm.py`, which authenticates to the gateway with `celai get api-key`.

repos.what: Metadata Platform documentation — the shared metadata services under the data platform.
Engineering documentation for CPM (the on-premise Celonis Process Mining 4.x product line).
Documentation for the CPM → EMS migration project.
Celonis fork of the Zalando RESTful API guidelines — the normative rules for HTTP API design.
Celonis Kubernetes best practices.
Curated log of the Landing Zone project's architectural decisions.
A compilation of PnE (Product & Engineering) best practices as of 2026 and beyond.

The Knowledge Lake itself — a Python/FastAPI monorepo that extracts, indexes (Milvus, dense + BM25) and serves internal Celonis knowledge over REST, MCP, the CeloAssist Slack bot and the Ask Celonis platform assistant.
